items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I learned a huge amount about the business just playing beside people like Vic Dickinson and Bobby Hackett for example.

ctx.x: Reed players all the time. I learned a huge amount about the business just playing beside people like Vic Dickinson and Bobby Hackett for example.
So Toronto was a stop for those guys on their criss-crossing of the country.
